name: WF4 - New Follower → Milestone Email to Owner

parameters.query:
SELECT b.id AS business_id, b.name AS business_name,
       u.email AS owner_email, u.first_name AS owner_first_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followed_businesses fb WHERE fb.business_id = b.id) AS followers
FROM businesses b
JOIN user_businesses ub ON ub.business_id = b.id
JOIN users u ON u.id = ub.user_id
WHERE b.id = $1
LIMIT 1;
